name: Build Snapshot
on:
  workflow_call:
    outputs:
      snapshot_name:
        description: "The name of the Daytona snapshot"
        value: ${{ jobs.build_snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}

jobs:
  build_snapshot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Get commit hash
        id: commit
        run: |
          echo "commit_hash=$(git rev-parse HEAD)" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          echo "short_hash=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Validate commit hash
        run: |
          if [[ "${{ env.commit_hash }}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "Commit hash is valid"
          else
            echo "Invalid commit hash format"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Build snapshot name
        id: snapshot
        run: |
          SNAPSHOT_NAME="iterate-sandbox-${{ env.commit_hash }}"
          echo "snapshot_name=$SNAPSHOT_NAME" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Set snapshot name as environment variable
        run: |
          echo "DAYTONA_SNAPSHOT_NAME=${{ steps.snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Output snapshot name
        id: output
        run: |
          echo "snapshot_name=${{ steps.snapshot.outputs.snapshot_name }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    outputs:
      snapshot_name: ${{ steps.output.outputs.snapshot_name }}
